docs.purpose: The one web STATIC binding: StaticBinding.tsx maps one page of the static page table (closed section kinds prose and footer, scripts/surfaces/_schema/static-page.schema.json) to a props tree (content refs only) and renders it with the mapped Mantine parts (bindings.json mapping.web.STATIC). It holds no display text of its own.
docs.data_story: It reads nothing itself: the mount file passes the page, the content strings and the one action (an error boundary's reset).
docs.under_126: **PROMOTED BINDING ENTRY** (P42-D9 a; Spec 126 §11b.5, the first web consumer of STATIC; MF-46 plan v3 §3.2 and §12 fold 13): a platform_shared census entry that owns the binding module, so R-13 totality holds while the converted surfaces own no component.

identity.owner: Admin domain (Spec 126 §14 Target Files) — the conversion programme owns the row; no individual owner is named by Specs 126/127/128.
spec_refs: docs/specs/02-web-admin/126_maxbld_surface_standard.md §11b.5 — per-archetype infrastructure on first use (MF-46, the first web STATIC consumer)

versioning.why: A binding module has no wire contract of its own: its input is the static page table, whose shape is static-page.schema.json, and its output is library parts. A change shows up as a golden or render-smoke failure of a consumer.
evidence: src/tests/surfaces/admin-media.golden.test.ts — T7: the consumer web goldens equal a fresh build
src/tests/surfaces/static-web-binding.ui.test.tsx — the web render smoke of every STATIC golden

inputs.why: The page, the content and the action arrive as props from the mount file.

state.why: No store and no local state.

staleness.why: It renders what it is given.

session.why: Its consumers are the public MaxBLD plain pages (Help & Support, Terms, Privacy) and their error and not-found boundaries; each consumer declares its own guard.

checks.why: The module is listed in bindings.json modules and owned by this entry (FE-31 C-3); a module nobody owns is a hand-built component.

Spec 128 R-18: guards.session anon equals the class of every consumer page (public host-table rows on maxbld.ca); the binding calls no contract. Checked by src/tests/surfaces/auth-class-parity.infra.test.ts.

errors.why: Errors belong to the consuming surface; the binding throws on an unknown kind, role, component, content key or action so a gap is loud.

metering.why: Rendering is not a metered product action.

sharing.why: Every converted web STATIC surface (the MaxBLD plain pages first; the landing, MF-76, later).
sharing.varies_by_surface: Only the page, content and action passed in.

notes: MF-46 stage C (operator D-2 (a), 2026-11-11 "1 y 2 y ..."; Spec 126 §11b.5). Archetype STATIC: the entry carries the archetype of the module it owns.

programme.why: Shared rendering infrastructure: the binding every converted web STATIC surface renders through.
